g.text: Most lost requirements are new at each compaction; 0-27% were

g.text: Inherited = lost at an earlier compaction of the same run and still lost. Pooled over all compactions of an arm; compactions in one run are not independent, so

g.text: the 95% Wilson intervals are rough guides only. Codex 80k is an induced early trigger and is not pooled with Codex 150k.
